title: What the freeze is read from
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0132 no longer matches the current design.
decision: The freeze is held by review (0143); what is frozen is read from the record, the cut's examples, checks and concepts as recorded.
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
